content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Matric / 10th pass from recognized board; Minimum 05 days training from Agriculture and Horticulture Directorate, Jharkhand Age limit: Minimum 18 years and maximum age limit unreserved category 35 years and BC/SC/ST 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: Unreserved 35, BC/OBC 40, SC/ST 40 Other conditions: Must have knowledge of local language Must be proficient in riding a bicycle and climbing trees Must be a local resident of Seraikela-Kharsawan district Desirable: Training of more than 05 days from Agriculture and Horticulture Directorate, Jharkhand will be given preference

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Government of Jharkhand Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications with incomplete details, missing certificates, unmet eligibility or false information will be rejected

content_sections.heading: Government of Jharkhand Crop Guard (Kamdar) Job Description
content_sections.text: Conducting crop surveys in assigned areas. Spraying insecticides and pesticides. Organising farmer training programmes and spreading agricultural awareness. Carrying out other official tasks assigned by the office from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Selected candidate will be appointed for 01 year or until regular appointments are made, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How Will Government of Jharkhand Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of application forms Evaluation based on 100 marks (Academic percentage, training days, cycling/tree climbing skill, and interview) Marks distribution includes 60 marks for 10th percentage, 12 marks for 05-day training, 8 extra marks for training over 5 days, and 20 marks for interview.

content_sections.heading: Government of Jharkhand Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Training of less than 5 days is not counted in the merit list

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Matric/10th passing certificate and marksheet Minimum 05 days training certificate Valid local resident certificate issued by competent authority Voter ID/Aadhaar card photocopy

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Government of Jharkhand Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the notice or website. Fill the application completely and attach self-attested copies of required documents. Submit the application by hand or through registered/speed post to the office of the Sub-Divisional Agriculture Officer, Seraikela. Make sure it reaches by 14 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Character certificate is not required with application but must be submitted at the time of joining/document verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Government of Jharkhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Government of Jharkhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies for Crop Guard (Kamdar).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Government of Jharkhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Pages 7-9 of this PDF) and send it to Sub-Divisional Agriculture Officer (Gen), Seraikela, Near Block Office Seraikela, Post-Seraikela, District-Seraikela-Kharsawan, Pin-833219, by registered/speed post or by hand, to reach by 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and maximum age limit unreserved category 35 years and BC/SC/ST 40 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: Unreserved 35, BC/OBC 40, SC/ST 40.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 11851 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum 10th pass with 05 days training in agriculture/horticulture.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must have knowledge of local language. Must be proficient in riding a bicycle and climbing trees. Must be a local resident of Seraikela-Kharsawan district.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications with incomplete details, missing certificates, unmet eligibility or false information will be rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of application forms. Evaluation based on 100 marks (Academic percentage, training days, cycling/tree climbing skill, and interview). Marks distribution includes 60 marks for 10th percentage, 12 marks for 05-day training, 8 extra marks for training over 5 days, and 20 marks for interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selected candidate will be appointed for 01 year or until regular appointments are made, whichever is earlier.
